description: A schema-versioned longitudinal self-evaluation snapshot recorded by the atperson entity: cumulative actions executed vs. admitted, terminal social-intent success, reply/quote ratio, valence drift, familiarity growth, and a bounded per-period trace. The record object mirrors the entity's durable metric store so the locally stored record can be published in full to the entity's PDS; the store adds a format/version persistence envelope that publication omits. Record key is the TID frozen at pass time; lexicographic order is the weekly series order.

at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant when the pass produced this snapshot.

period_start.description: RFC 3339 UTC start of the cadence period the trace summarises.

period_end.description: RFC 3339 UTC end of the cadence period the trace summarises.

cadence_seconds.description: The configured minimum gap between snapshots; the period length this snapshot covers.

actions.description: Cumulative outbound action execution: attempts and how each was resolved.

interaction.description: Cumulative pending-social-intent outcomes (#150): terminal conversations by state.

reply_ratio.description: Cumulative reply fraction of public references to the entity's executed actions.

valence.description: Cumulative explicit valence-state updates and their net drift.

familiarity.description: Cumulative author exposure growth from the observation ledger.

previous.description: The immediately preceding snapshot in the series, so trend deltas are derivable from the stored sequence. Absent on the first snapshot.

trace.description: Bounded trace of the per-period activity each metric summarises; the provenance of the numbers.

deferred.description: Attempts deferred under a rate/window constraint.

dry_run.description: Attempts observed under dry-run mode; informational, not in the success denominator.

success_rate.description: executed / attempts over all recorded attempts, in per-mille (0..1000). Lexicons have no fractional type, so ratios are scaled x1000.

invites_replied.description: Conversations that reached their continuation budget (Closed).

invites_expired.description: Conversations whose reply window closed unanswered (Expired).

success_rate.description: invites_replied / (invites_replied + invites_expired) over terminal intents in per-mille; 0 when none have resolved.

replies.description: Events referencing through the reply parent field.

ratio.description: replies / events over all linked events, in per-mille.

tokens.description: Distinct tokens holding any valence update.

drift.description: Net signal sum across all updates in per-mille of signal scale; cumulative drift.

authors.description: Distinct authors observed in learned ledger entries.

new_authors.description: Authors first observed within this period.

accretion.description: new_authors / authors in per-mille; the period's author growth fraction.

at.description: When the previous snapshot was produced.

episodes.description: Learned episodes observed within the period.

events.description: Linked public events within the period.

resolutions.description: Expectation resolutions recorded within the period.

valence_updates.description: Valence updates applied within the period.

new_authors.description: Suffix of author DIDs first observed in this period, bounded to the pass's trace cap.

top_valence.description: Period valence movement grouped by (token, kind), strongest |sum| first, bounded to the pass's trace cap.

kind.description: The valence kind. knownValues is open.

sum.description: Net signal across the grouped updates, in per-mille of signal scale.
